name: fcc-broker-relay
description: Personal, read-only broker relay for the Finance Command Center app. Runs in your own Cloudflare account; stores and logs nothing.

RELAY_KEY.description: Paste the **relay key** shown in the Finance Command Center app (Settings → Live broker connections → *Create relay key*). It makes sure only your app can use this relay.

ALLOWED_ORIGIN.description: The address of the Finance Command Center app. Leave it as it is unless you use your own copy of the app.
